title: nucleic — primeval

sentences.sentence: Organisms rely on phosphorus to build nucleic acids and other molecules to grow and proliferate.

sentences.sentence: Working with subsurface ice, brine or soil samples, SETG would attempt to isolate, amplify, detect and identify nucleic acids -- right there on Mars.
sentences.translation: SETG研究了地下冰、盐水或土壤样本，试图隔离、放大、监测和识别核酸，这种核算恰好就在火星上。

sentences.sentence: Thus, any random changes in the interior, fledgling ribozymes that could speed up nucleic acid replication rates will spread rapidly through an evolving population.
sentences.translation: 这样一来，细胞内部发生的使得核酶加速核酸复制速率的任何变化，都会在进化群体中快速扩散。

sentences.translation: 与此同时，在其他问题上，比如经济刺激计划、医保改革以及伊拉克问题，他不止一次改弦易辙、转向中庸，这让他最热心的支持者感到失望。

sentences.sentence: The most visited city in the world, here is a capital whose great talent has been to interweave the grandeur of its official buildings with the everyday charm of its many quartiers.

英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 346 单元

nucleic
音标：英 /njuː'kliːɪk/  美 /nu'kliɪk/
adj. 核的
短语：nucleic acid — [生化]核酸
例句：Organisms rely on phosphorus to build nucleic acids and other molecules to grow and proliferate.
有机物依赖于磷来制造核酸和其他生长与繁殖所需的分子。
例句：Working with subsurface ice, brine or soil samples, SETG would attempt to isolate, amplify, detect and identify nucleic acids -- right there on Mars.
SETG研究了地下冰、盐水或土壤样本，试图隔离、放大、监测和识别核酸，这种核算恰好就在火星上。
例句：Thus, any random changes in the interior, fledgling ribozymes that could speed up nucleic acid replication rates will spread rapidly through an evolving population.
这样一来，细胞内部发生的使得核酶加速核酸复制速率的任何变化，都会在进化群体中快速扩散。

pavement

hover

completion
音标：英 /kəm'pliːʃn/  美 /kəm'pliʃən/
n. 完成
短语：well completion — 完井；钻井完成
短语：completion date — 竣工日期；完工日期

短语：completion rate — 布通率；完成比例
短语：final completion — 最终完工，竣工

短语：time of completion — 竣工时间
短语：completion of works — 完工；工程竣工

房子即将完工。

该项目的完成日期是12月22日。

abound
音标：英 /ə'baʊnd/  美 /ə'baʊnd/

短语：abound with — 充满

音标：英 /'lɪpɪd/  美 /lɪpɪd/
